sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:110655
Court No. - 68

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 23770 of 2025
Applicant :- Satyendra Trivedi

Opposite Party :- State Of Uttar Pradesh
Counsel for Applicant :- Prakhar Tandon
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.

Heard Sri Prakhar Tandon, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Padmakar Rai, learned A.G.A.
and perused the record.

2. The instant application has been filed to enlarge the applicant on bail in case crime No. 184 of 2024, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 447, 147, 120B of I.P.C., Police Station- Bilhaur, District- Kanpur Nagar, during the pendency of trial.

3. Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that from a bare perusal of the FIR as well as statements of the witnesses, it is clear that the dispute is purely civil in nature and the only allegation against the applicant is that he along with other co-accused, tried to forcibly take possession of the land of the first informant.

It is further submitted that co-accused Pradeep Bajpai and Deepu have already been granted bail by the Coordinate Bench of this Court in Bail Applications No. 6569 of 2025 and 3282 of 2025, respectively.

sentences.text: Therefore, the applicant is also entitled to be released on bail on the ground of parity with co-accused Pradeep and Deepu.

The applicant has explained his criminal history in the accompanying affidavit and he is languishing in jail since Satyendra Trivedi vs State Of Uttar Pradesh on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159212449/
1 11.6.2025.

sentences.text: In case, he is granted bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and would cooperate in the trial proceedings.
4. On the other hand, learned A.G.A. for the State opposed the prayer for bail, but he could not dispute the aforesaid fact.

5. Thus, considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

6. Let the applicant- Satyendra Trivedi, involved in the aforementioned crime be released on bail, on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of the court concerned, with the following conditions:-
i.

The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
ii. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial/investigation sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
iii. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
iv. The applicant shall attend in accordance with the conditions of the bond executed by him.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
8. Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the court concerned before the bonds are accepted.

Order Date :- 10.7.2025 Vandana  Satyendra Trivedi vs State Of Uttar Pradesh on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/159212449/
